text: Imran Shafiq holds account PK**HABB****4503 opened on 14 December 2023. The subject declares occupation Student and a monthly income of PKR 20,000 per month. Between 1 June 2026 and 10 June 2026 the account received 20 credits totalling PKR 1,058,000 and made 4 debits totalling PKR 989,000. All 20 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 14 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 10 June 2026, scoring a typology MULE-01 of 360 against a threshold of 300. Taken together, these observations are indicative of suspected money mule activity. PKR 549,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 2 transactions. PKR 440,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 2 transactions. Screening on 28 June 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer.
